description: Set one timeline clip's visible duration by moving only its timeline end (TrackItem.end) while keeping its start fixed. Pass exactly one of duration_seconds or end_seconds. Works for extending still images past their import length. Refuses to overlap the next clip on the same track, rejects shortening that would strand effect keyframes unless keyframe_policy is preserve, reads start/end back, and restores the original end if Premiere clamps or ignores the write (for example when video media has no handle left). Linked audio/video partners are not adjusted. Use this instead of speed changes, which Premiere does not expose to scripting.

duration_seconds.description: Target visible duration in seconds, measured from the clip's current timeline start. Specify exactly one of duration_seconds or end_seconds.

end_seconds.description: Target absolute timeline end (out-point) in seconds. Must be at least one frame after the clip's start. Specify exactly one of duration_seconds or end_seconds.

keyframe_policy.description: When shortening, how to handle effect keyframes beyond the new visible length: reject (default) leaves the timeline unchanged; preserve keeps them and reports their count.

node_id.description: Node ID of the timeline clip (track item) to resize

name: set_clip_duration

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.
